title: Feasibility models for the starter product ideas
description: Six product ideas from the starter set (workspaces/coding-build/templates/product-ideas.seed.json), each as a product record that must pass Mynt's product checks, with a term sheet. The desk agent must build a feasibility model for it in the benchmark firm's repository; a task passes when Mynt itself runs that model in a clean sandbox and gets a well-formed report with one of the expected verdicts.

product.name: 6-Month No-Penalty CD
product.description: A 6-month certificate of deposit that can be closed early without an early withdrawal penalty after the first week.
key_features: Fixed rate for a 6-month term, set by the firm at opening
Close it and take the whole balance any time after the first 7 days, with no early withdrawal penalty
Opening minimum and maximum set in the firm's terms
Reminder before maturity with the choice to renew or move the money out

tasks.goal: Build a feasibility model for 6-Month No-Penalty CD: unit economics per account at the term sheet's inputs, a stress scenario, and the regulatory limits that apply, then run it.

product.name: Goal-Locked Money Market Sub-Accounts
product.description: A money market account split into named sub-accounts, each locked to a goal date the holder chooses.
key_features: Up to ten named sub-accounts under one money market account
Each sub-account has a goal amount and a goal date the holder sets
Taking money out of a sub-account before its date needs a waiting period the holder chose at opening
One statement shows every sub-account's balance

tasks.goal: Build a feasibility model for Goal-Locked Money Market Sub-Accounts: unit economics per account at the term sheet's inputs, a stress scenario, and the regulatory limits that apply, then run it.

product.name: 24-Month CD with One Rate Reset
product.description: A 24-month certificate of deposit with one request during the term to move to the rate the firm then offers for new CDs of the same term.
key_features: Fixed rate for a 24-month term
One reset request allowed during the term, to the rate the firm offers that day for new 24-month CDs
The rate after a reset may be higher or lower than the opening rate, and applies for the rest of the term
Early withdrawal penalty as stated in the firm's terms

tasks.goal: Build a feasibility model for 24-Month CD with One Rate Reset: unit economics per account at the term sheet's inputs, a stress scenario, and the regulatory limits that apply, then run it.

product.name: Starter IRA with Payday Contributions
product.description: An individual retirement account with no opening minimum, funded by a small fixed amount from each paycheck.
key_features: No minimum opening amount
A fixed amount the holder picks moves in on each payday
Contributions this year shown next to the yearly limit in the account's terms
Holdings limited to the firm's listed fund menu

tasks.goal: Build a feasibility model for Starter IRA with Payday Contributions: unit economics per account at the term sheet's inputs, a stress scenario, and the regulatory limits that apply, then run it.

product.name: Quarterly Tax Reserve in a Money Market Fund
product.description: A money market fund holding with a separate balance for each estimated tax quarter and reminders before each due date.
key_features: A separate balance for each estimated tax quarter
Reminders before each estimated tax due date
Shares sold and cash sent to a linked bank account on any business day
States plainly that a money market fund is not a deposit account

tasks.goal: Build a feasibility model for Quarterly Tax Reserve in a Money Market Fund: unit economics per account at the term sheet's inputs, a stress scenario, and the regulatory limits that apply, then run it.

product.name: TIPS Ladder Bundle
product.description: One purchase of Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities with staggered maturities, one rung maturing each year over a span the holder picks.
key_features: One rung maturing each year over a span of 3 to 10 years the holder picks
Every rung's maturity date and interest payment dates shown before purchase
Principal adjusted for changes in the Consumer Price Index as the securities' terms state
Each rung's cash moves to a linked account at maturity

tasks.goal: Build a feasibility model for TIPS Ladder Bundle: unit economics per account at the term sheet's inputs, a stress scenario, and the regulatory limits that apply, then run it.
